LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_SettingsUnavailable: Could not read settings. The pack keeps working with its built-in defaults (everything on).
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_OnlyCrashes_Tip: Turns off the "Log spam" and "Compatibility" groups, keeping only the ones that crash or freeze when unfixed. The two "Behaviour & settings" entries are left alone - those are your preferences, not bug fixes.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_StatusSomeOff: Status: {1} of {0} fixes are turned off.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_RestartHint: ★ Changes take effect after restarting the game - patches cannot be removed mid-session; this screen decides what gets installed on the next launch.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_assemblyGetTypesFa: One broken assembly no longer kills every patch

When a mod's dll references an assembly that is not installed, enumerating all types fails for everyone, and mods later in the list get skipped entirely. This turns 'the whole list is void' into 'a few types missing, the list is still usable'.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_techHediffsZeroBud: Implant generator crash at zero budget
Vanilla picks from a zero-weight list when the implant budget is exactly 0, gets null and crashes. This adds the missing null check.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_musicManagerFadeou: When an object that only claims to be an instrument ends up in the instruments group, music fadeout throws InvalidCastException every frame. This blocks it at the source and adds a safety net.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_nmmIdeoTrackerNull: NudityMattersMore's CoverBody.UpdateIdeo dereferences null when a stale entry with the same id is still cached, which breaks pawn generation - starting new games repeatedly freezes. This clears the stale entries first.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_alliesAreHelpfulCu: Allies are Helpful pawn null reference
That mod does not guard the common case where a pawn has no current job, so it reads a null object and aborts TickRare. This makes those Job reads null-safe.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_srceLibConcurrency: SRCELib's two static caches have no lock at all; concurrent rendering corrupts them, and some pawns throw on every draw and never appear. This wraps it in a lock.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_gfmIdleCombatDeepC: That mod's DeepCopy was copied from vanilla without changing the cast target, so it always throws InvalidCastException and three think-trees are never copied. This fixes just those two IL instructions.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_ccoeReflection_Des: Three CCOE prefix methods throw TargetException when the pawn has no matching component, failing menstruation settlement and spamming red text. This makes all three safe.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_fixVfeeInstrumentS: Adds the missing null guard to VFE Empire's crashing check: without it the room requirements of nine noble titles (Archcount / Marquess / Archduke ...) do not work. Usually you do not need to turn this off - it probes the vanilla code and steps aside once the author fixes it.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_crossPromotionUnpa: Crash when opening the Mods page
CrossPromotion calls a long-deprecated Steam interface while drawing the mods page, so opening it crashes. This removes that prefix.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_steamWorkshopHook: Steam workshop info crash (second safety net)
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_steamWorkshopHook_: The other path of the same crash: catches nulls and exceptions along the 'get workshop info' chain. Keeping both on is safest.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_baseGenMimicSpawne: Generating ancient shrines logs a 'no RuleDef for mimicSpawner' warning per tile (34 per map in testing). Vanilla's path already rejects and does nothing, so this only stops the spam.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_rjwGenesSpamQuiet_: In dev mode it logs '[RJW-Genes] multipreg checks' every frame (30k lines, 65 percent of the log in one session), burying real problems. This blocks only that one string.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_vehicleFrameworkDe: After building the dev spawn menu, that mod errors out when a PawnKind is not found. This turns 'error out' into 'silently skip'.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_filterRjwpeStaleDe: RJW PE's SoundDef_Replacement.xml uses the old type name rjwpe.SoundReplacementDef (renamed to rjwpe.VoiceReplacementDef on 2025-09-04; the newer ReplacementDef_Voice.xml already implements the feature), so it always logs 'Type ... is not a Def type'. Those defs never worked; this removes them, which is equivalent to the current behaviour minus the red text. Self-disables if the author ever adds the type back.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_riFurnitureRoyalCo: Logs 54 lines on every launch saying the royal room-requirement patch did not take effect. Cause: disroom.mashiro wipes throneRoomRequirements / bedroomRequirements entirely, which is the effect the player deliberately enabled, so RI's furniture can never be added - an expected design clash. This mutes only that self-check; all other logs from the mod are untouched.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_patchVerbPropertie: Vanilla uses the attacker without checking for null in two places, which spams null references in some cases. This adds the missing checks.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_patchModListerHasA: XML patch mod-name checks fail in Chinese

In Chinese the DLC display names are translated (Royalty becomes the localized name), so patches testing for the English short name silently fail and whole patch blocks are skipped with no log line. This accepts both forms.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlExtensionsFindM: The same 'match DLC by name' problem, but on XmlExtensions' own code path (separate from the other fix here; both must be on).
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_patchGenTypesPrefe: RaceGeneDef resolves to the right assembly
When telanda's animal gene mod and ElToro Patches are both present, the same type name exists in two assemblies. This makes telanda's one win; when telanda is absent it does nothing.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_patchLoadModXMLFil: ElToro Patches vs telanda defName clash
Both mods define a full set of RaceGeneDefs and 25 names collide exactly, overwriting each other. This stops the clash; when telanda is absent it also quietly drops the unconsumed tables.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_patchListerThingsR: Non-instruments kept out of the instruments group
Checks at registration time whether an object claims to be an instrument but is not, and rejects it - so nothing can get in. Pairs with the music fadeout fix.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_keepLeaderTitle_De: On: leader titles you set (Chairman, Pope, ...) are never re-rolled by randomize-symbols or meme changes. Off: fully back to vanilla behaviour. To change a title, clear it (or turn this off), then randomize once.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_cumpilationSetting: Counteract Menstruation Fluids forcing Cumpilation settings off

'RJW Menstruation Fluids' unconditionally writes 9 Cumpilation settings to false on every launch, so turning them on in the settings UI does not stick (it only changes memory, never disk). This restores the values you saved.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlPatchGate: Let XML patches be toggled individually
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlPatchGate_Desc: ON: each XML patch file below gets its own toggle; turning one off disables only that file's fixes. OFF: every XML patch runs as usual (equivalent to turning them all on). This entry only decides whether the toggles take effect; it fixes nothing by itself.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlConfigErrorClea: Several independent small fixes live in one file: the quantum cooler's shot/sight exemption, the Sex_MC_UAP bracket exemption, softresin being treated as equipment, plus [33] LT chastity belt/bra durability and flammability, [34] duplicate gene-category priority, [35] a non-existent field on the OA accounting record, and [36] three dangling cross-references.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlDamageDefPurifi: Fortification Industrial - Citadel lists PurificationBurn in damageMultipliers, but it is a HediffDef in Monolyn Race, so every load logs "No Verse.DamageDef named". This removes the multiplier entry that never worked.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlElToroAnimsRott: Dangling Rotti reference in the animal animations ([7])
The animation defs still list the removed Rotti race, causing dangling-reference errors at load.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlTY2ValleyArtill: Valley turret references a removed type ([13])
The mod injects VFE Security's removed CompProperties_LongRangeArtillery into a turret, so the whole Def fails to load and the turret disappears. This removes that node.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlIncestuosIssueR: The incest-permission mod removes the issue node from Incestuos_Disapproved_CloseOnly while its preceptClass is empty, flooding 350 null-reference errors when the ideoligion screen opens. This restores only the issue field.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlMiliraNavigator: The uniform overrides the parent's apparel/layers and comps with whitespace-only empty elements, so every recolor logs "Failed to get last layer" and the avoid-ally-damage comp is lost.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlOasfcTsarXenoty: That template has no xenotypeSet, so pawns spawn as ordinary baseliners. This adds a fixed one.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlSnowRabbitTatto: SnowRabbit tattoo icon path case mismatch ([19])
The iconPath differs in case from the actual file on disk, spamming the ideoligion screen. This restores the real name.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlVfeeRoyalTitleE: VFE Empire royal title extensions wiped ([3])

disroom.mashiro replaces every title's modExtensions with an empty list, and WorldComponent_Hierarchy does not null-check when reading them, aborting world-component initialization. This restores them per effective def. WARNING: patch-on-patch — this mod must load after disroom.mashiro.
LanguageData.GNH_LocalFixes_Toggle_xmlVfePianoFirepit: VFE's own PatchOperationFindMod compares display names, and under Chinese Royalty becomes a different string. This redoes those 8 operations. NOTE: if the FindMod language fix is enabled, VFE runs them itself and this one matches zero nodes.
